description: This file defines an immutable implementation of the SubjectType interface, providing factory methods and overriding core object methods.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectType
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SubjectType interface, encapsulating a string value and providing character sequence methods.

methods.name: of

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the subject type string.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the subject type string.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks object equality based on the subjectType string.

methods.description: Computes hash code based on subjectType string.
